caption: The drawing depicts a standing human figure dressed in multiple layers of clothing. The person wears a large, floppy, light gray or beige hat that appears misshapen and partially covers the head. The face is painted black with prominent red lips and white around the eyes and mouth, with a white beard or facial hair. The figure is wearing a brown sleeveless vest or tunic over a red long-sleeved shirt, with blue sleeves extending from underneath. The vest is loosely tied at the chest with a white strap or rope. The hands are covered by black gloves. The lower part of the body is dressed in blue pants that have green or beige patches sewn on both knees. The shoes are dark in color, with patches on top, matching the worn look of the clothing. Behind the figure, to the left side, there is a large, gray, cloud-like shape that resembles a puff of smoke. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or scenery visible.
title: Costume Doll
